cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.

mechanism: A treats its sibling apology email as unfinished writing instruction, requiring named damage and first-person responsibility before remorse is valid.
confusable: Not simply wanting a nicer email: A controls the wording and order so a real misattribution is removed first.
comparison: Public spoken correction versus written subject and admission.
seedUse: D171 email/vase/sorry/Mum blames A; S05 taught letter clarity.
